correctness.rationale: Exact graph via sixteen XOR labels and five edge generators. Finite group action reduces six seed types to explicit representatives; none of size below three propagates, and exactly independent and induced-path triples succeed. Two explicit mutually inverse blind-spot representative calculations give the global involution. Independently coded full enumeration of all 696 seeds, 320 optimum configurations, 3,360 jump edges and 1,120 slide edges and exhaustive 51,040 pair distances verifies the unique maximum-distance involution and full penalty distribution. Both supplied code paths completed with PASS. The theorem is finite; no extrapolation from samples to infinite orders.

value.rationale: The involution taking an optimal three-sensor placement to the three initially invisible vertices is shown to characterize its unique farthest optimum under physically local relocation. This connects the propagation obstruction with a sharp reconfiguration metric, and demonstrates that locally constrained movement doubles the diameter from 3 to 6 despite remaining connected. The exact 160 extremal pairs and full distance distribution are a meaningful complete benchmark for a natural strongly regular graph, rather than arbitrary tabulation or routine substitution.
